roots.summary: FDA clarifies that an Enforcement Report entry classifies an existing lettuce recall rather than announcing a new recall.
FDA announces a CBER roundtable on blood manufacturing and supply-chain resilience.
FDA reports a B. Braun sodium chloride injection recall involving particulate matter.
FDA notifies patients about mammography quality and compliance concerns at a Monterey facility.
FDA MedWatch shares an early safety alert involving an angiographic catheter.
FDA directs readers to complete details for a contamination-related medical product recall.
FDA amplifies the B. Braun sodium chloride injection recall involving particulate matter.
FDA MedWatch shares an early alert about an IV Start Kit issue.
FDA announces marketing authorization for JUUL2 tobacco- and menthol-flavored products.
FDA announces a public meeting on GDUFA reauthorization.
FDA announces a newly approved treatment for pediatric ulcerative colitis.
FDA announces a first-in-class treatment for erythrocytosis in adults with polycythemia vera.
FDA provides consumer FAQs explaining PFAS considerations in medical devices and directs readers to current information.
roots.theme: Medical Device Materials and Chemical Safety

roots.summary: FDA states that clinical-trial data must be inspectable, reliable, and ethically derived and warns sponsors that inaccessible sites affect regulatory decisions.
roots.theme: Clinical Trial Integrity and Inspection Enforcement

roots.summary: FDA reports that the Salmonella Enteritidis outbreak linked to recalled shell eggs is over and its investigation has closed.
FDA announces expanded oversight, inspection resources, and scrutiny for foreign clinical trial sites whose data or facilities cannot be adequately accessed.
roots.theme: Clinical Trial Oversight and Data Integrity
